title: Beauty's new flex is specificity and brands need to learn to translate it
summary: Search is changing in a way that it has not for decades, as people move from text-based searches towards visual-first discovery. Ayesha Mace, Head of Beauty at Pinterest UK, explains why in this phase, translation and specificity is what wins

extraction.key_fact: 검색이 글자에서 시각 중심 탐색으로 옮겨 가고 있어 뷰티 브랜드는 구체성을 전달해야 한다.
extraction.key_fact_quote: Search is changing in a way that it has not for decades, as people move from text-based searches towards visual-first discovery.
